extensionDescription.message: Firefox proxy profiles with page-visible location, timezone and WebRTC controls.

authNotice.message: Credentials are lost when Firefox exits. SOCKS4 does not support authentication.

pasteNotice.message: Explicit URL schemes take precedence. No automatic protocol detection. Enter credentials separately, not in a URL.

detailsNotice.message: Direct route uses Firefox and system routing without configuring an extension proxy. Session proxy credentials are kept only in memory until Firefox exits.

saved.message: Saved. Saving does not verify connectivity or change the active route.

applying.message: Saved. Applying route; identity lookup may finish separately…

appliedSeeStatus.message: Saved. See the current route and identity status for the activation result.

operationUnconfirmed.message: Could not confirm the operation. Check the profile list and retry.

socks4NoAuth.message: SOCKS4 cannot authenticate. Choose SOCKS5, HTTP or HTTPS.

uriCredentials.message: Remove credentials from the address and use the session-only authentication fields.

percentEndpoint.message: Percent-encoded endpoints are not supported. Enter the host directly.

chooseProtocol.message: Choose HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 or SOCKS5.

endpointOnly.message: Enter only a proxy host and port, without a path or query.

validHost.message: Enter a valid hostname, IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 address.

ipv6Brackets.message: Wrap an IPv6 address in brackets, for example [::1]:1080.

profileLimit.message: The profile limit has been reached.

nameUsed.message: That profile name is already used. Choose another name.

credentialsTraffic.message: Proxy credentials are required. Traffic remains restricted to this profile.

blockedTraffic.message: Traffic is blocked rather than sent directly. Retry this profile after the proxy returns.

refreshConsent.message: Refreshing a direct profile sends your public IP to the GeoIP provider. Allow collection to continue.

languageSaveFailed.message: Could not save language preference. Try again.

noMatchingProfiles.message: No matching profiles. Your active route is unchanged.
